name: Grovekeeper can spend the final specialization point beside the level-59 Seismic Smash grant (#9970)
contract: CharacterAdvancementEssence gives a Primalist 25 specialization points at level 60. Seismic Smash 300693 is
a Primalist class spell from level 59 and also the Mountain King talent entry 7498 (spec 60, TE 1). It
belongs to no Grovekeeper build, so it must not consume a Grovekeeper point. A Grovekeeper (spec 58)
uploads 24 Life entries of the 0 and 8 investment tiers, then buys entry 30966 (706138) with the 25th
point, which must be learned. Entry 30967 (805445) as a 26th point must still be refused.
